claim_ceiling: This experiment establishes no new evidence for C-PRODUCT-ECON or C-PARAM-INHERIT. Maximum justified claim remains the parent analytical ceiling (EXP-PRODUCT-35330741529, audit REVISE): on the frozen synthetic 32-task corpus (6 domains, heuristic regex induction, 32 literal vs 25 parameterized mechanisms, 21.9% storage reduction) with tiktoken cl100k_base prompt counting and hard-coded completion estimates (2 tokens selection, 15-20 completion), parameterized model token cost (selection+resolution only, browser/verification omitted, no LLM executed, 100% success assumed) is 18624 vs 19691 tokens (5.42% savings, 1067 tokens; selection saving 3168 tokens 16.09% vs resolution overhead 2101 tokens 10.67%), positive collapse 5 blog tasks to 1 pattern, null ratio 1.0185 for search. This experiment (0/32 tasks executed, 0 tokens measured, 0% selection accuracy measured, no resolution binding observed) does not validate, extend, or falsify that ceiling. Real LLM selection accuracy, real completion token distribution, real resolution success, total workflow cost (selection+resolution) vs literal, COLD viability, and browser/verification economics all remain UNMEASURED. C-PRODUCT-ECON remains HYPOTHESIS; C-PARAM-INHERIT remains EXPERIMENTAL at committed-code synthetic single-slot analytical ceiling. No product promotion justified. Do not assume 5.42% survives real execution.
